title: A Collaborative Content Moderation Framework for Toxicity Detection based on Multitask Neural Networks and Conformal Estimates of Annotation Disagreement

bias_targets.methodology: Modeling inter-annotator disagreement as an auxiliary regression task in a multitask neural network, and evaluating the model's ability to predict this subjective ambiguity using metrics like Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and the proposed Comment Ambiguity-aware Review Efficiency (CARE) metric.
